description: This file defines a React hook and a utility function for progressive expansion processing. It includes createProgressiveExpandController, which manages batched processing of work items with time-slicing and optional React integration via useProgressiveExpand, a custom React hook that wraps the controller for UI state management.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller to process items in batches with time-slicing, supporting progress and cancellation callbacks.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: A React hook that manages UI state for the batching process enabled by createProgressiveExpandController.
